lines.trans: Thank goodness you are here, Tariq—we were afraid of bending the painted lid.
Never force old tin, Nour; one tiny drop of warm oil loosens any rim.
How long does the oil need before we try turning the corners?
Count to five, press the centre gently with one thumb, and lift evenly.
One, two, three, four, five... it popped right open without a scratch!

words.gloss: I opened / you (m) opened / she opened

lines.trans: Smell that? Cedar shavings, dry paper, and faint peppermint from thirty years ago.
Oh, Tariq, look at what is sitting right on top in a velvet pouch!
A solid brass pocket compass with a glass cover and a blued steel needle.

words.gloss: with a cover / in a cover

lines.trans: Watch the little needle spin as I set it flat on the wooden table!

words.gloss: you turn / she turns / you wrap
in a way / in a shape

lines.trans: Still balanced to the degree—pointing straight out the window past the shade tree.

words.gloss: to the wild / to the outside

lines.trans: Look inside the brass cover: there are tiny initials engraved beside a star.
A mapmaker never travels without a good compass, so leaving this behind meant a lot.

meanings.note: Plural of حرف (harf), meaning letters.

examples.text: كم أحرف في الكلمة؟
examples.trans: How many letters are in the word?

examples.text: لازم تكتب اسمك بأحرف واضحة عالاستمارة.
examples.trans: You need to write your name in clear letters on the form.

meanings.note: The number four, used with masculine nouns.

examples.text: اشتريت أربعة كتب.
examples.trans: I bought four books.

examples.text: وصلوا الضيوف الساعة أربعة العصر.
examples.trans: The guests arrived at four in the afternoon.

meanings.note: Everyday word for rice. Often pronounced 'ruz' in Jordanian.

examples.text: طبخنا أرز ودجاج اليوم.
examples.trans: We cooked rice and chicken today.

examples.text: حطي كاستين أرز بسمتي مع مرقة الدجاج.
examples.trans: Put two cups of basmati rice with the chicken broth.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian word for seeing a group of people.

examples.text: أشوفكم بكرة في المدرسة.
examples.trans: I will see you tomorrow at school.

examples.text: يلا مع السلامة، أشوفكم الأسبوع الجاي إن شاء الله.
examples.trans: Alright, goodbye—see you all next week, God willing.

meanings.note: Feminine of أول (awwal).

examples.text: هاي المرة الأولى اللي بزور فيها البتراء.
examples.trans: This is the first time I visit Petra.

examples.text: العيلة دايماً إلها الأولوية الأولى بحياتنا.
examples.trans: Family always has the first priority in our lives.

meanings.note: Used as a question word or indefinite pronoun.

examples.text: أي سيارة بتفضل؟
examples.trans: Which car do you prefer?

examples.text: بأي ساعة رح يبلش الاجتماع اليوم؟
examples.trans: At what hour is the meeting going to start today?

meanings.note: إن (that) + ك (you).

examples.text: بعرف إنك مشغول.
examples.trans: I know that you are busy.

examples.text: فرحت كتير لما عرفت إنك نجحت بالامتحان.
examples.trans: I was so happy when I found out that you passed the exam.

meanings.note: The number two. Often pronounced 'tnēn' in Jordanian.

examples.text: عندي ولاد اثنين.
examples.trans: I have two children.

examples.text: طلبنا فنجانين قهوة وكاستين شاي للاثنين.
examples.trans: We ordered two cups of coffee and two glasses of tea for the two of us.

meanings.note: Can refer to a sewing needle or a medical syringe in Jordanian Arabic.

examples.text: الدكتور أعطاه الإبرة عشان يرتاح.
examples.trans: The doctor gave him the injection so he would rest.

examples.text: لضمت الخيط بالإبرة عشان ترقّع المفرش المشقوق.
examples.trans: She threaded the needle to mend the torn tablecloth.

meanings.note: Usually heard in the phrase 'Alhamdulillah' (Praise be to God).

examples.text: الحمد لله على السلامة.
examples.trans: Praise be to God for your safety.

examples.text: كل الناس بقولوا الحمد لله لما يسمعوا خبر منيح.
examples.trans: Everyone says praise be to God when they hear good news.

meanings.note: Colloquial plural for 'khareeta' (map).

examples.text: استخدمنا الخرايط عشان نلاقي الطريق.
examples.trans: We used the maps to find the way.

examples.text: فتحت الخرايط على التلفون عشان أشوف الأزمة وين.
examples.trans: I opened the maps on my phone to see where the traffic jam is.

meanings.note: Collective noun for wood material or timber.

examples.text: الطاولة هاي مصنوعة من الخشب الزان.
examples.trans: This table is made of beech wood.

examples.text: النجار قص الخشب وزبط القياسات للخزانة.
examples.trans: The carpenter cut the wood and adjusted the measurements for the closet.

meanings.note: Plural of zaawiya (corner/angle).

examples.text: لازم ننظف كل الزوايا بالغرفة.
examples.trans: We must clean all the corners in the room.

examples.text: مسحنا الزوايا والرفوف قبل ما نرجع الكتب مكانها.
examples.trans: We wiped down the corners and shelves before putting the books back.

meanings.note: Most commonly refers to olive oil (zeit zaytoun) in Jordan, or motor oil.

examples.text: جيب معاك تنكة الزيت من البلد.
examples.trans: Bring the tin of oil with you from the village.

examples.text: سخنت الزيت بالمقلاية عشان أقلي البطاطا.
examples.trans: I heated the oil in the pan to fry the potatoes.

meanings.note: The standard word for a window in a house.

examples.text: افتح الشباك شوي.
examples.trans: Open the window a little.

examples.text: سكرت الشباك عشان الغبرة ما تفوت عالصالون.
examples.trans: I closed the window so the dust wouldn't get into the living room.

meanings.note: Feminine form of small.

examples.text: السيارة الصغيرة أسرع.
examples.trans: The small car is faster.

examples.text: اختي الصغيرة بلشت صف أول هاي السنة.
examples.trans: My little sister started first grade this year.

meanings.note: The universal word for table.

examples.text: حط الأكل على الطاولة.
examples.trans: Put the food on the table.

examples.text: حطينا الشاي والقهوة على الطاولة بالنص.
examples.trans: We put the tea and coffee on the table in the middle.

meanings.note: Used for shade from the sun.

examples.text: خلينا نقعد في الظل.
examples.trans: Let's sit in the shade.

examples.text: صفينا السيارة تحت الشجرة عشان تضل في الظل.
examples.trans: We parked the car under the tree so it would stay in the shade.

meanings.note: Used for a pot lid or a blanket.

examples.text: سكر الطنجرة في الغطا.
examples.trans: Close the pot with the lid.

examples.text: مش لاقي الغطا تبع المطرة اللي خدتها عالنادي.
examples.trans: I can't find the lid for the water bottle I took to the gym.

meanings.note: Passive participle meaning something that has been painted.

examples.text: الحيط المدهون لسه طري.
examples.trans: The painted wall is still wet.

examples.text: انتبه لا تلمس الباب المدهون لأنه لسه ما نشف.
examples.trans: Be careful not to touch the painted door because it hasn't dried yet.

meanings.note: Copper or brass.

examples.text: هذي الصينية من النحاس الأصلي.
examples.trans: This tray is made of authentic copper.

examples.text: غسلت إبريق القهوة النحاس بالليمون والملح عشان يلمع.
examples.trans: I washed the copper coffee pot with lemon and salt so it shines.

meanings.note: Can mean 'the half' (an-noSS) or 'the text' (an-naSS). Both meanings are extremely common.

examples.text: أكلت النص وخليت الباقي.
examples.trans: I ate half and left the rest.

examples.text: قسمنا الرغيف بالنص وأكل كل واحد شقفة.
examples.trans: We split the loaf in half and each person ate a piece.

meanings.note: With or by a thumb.

examples.text: بصم بإبهام إيده اليمين.
examples.trans: He fingerprinted with his right thumb.

examples.text: ثبت الكرت بإبهامه عالزاوية.
examples.trans: He held the card steady at the corner with his thumb.

meanings.note: Equally or evenly.

examples.text: قسمنا الكيكة بالتساوي.
examples.trans: We divided the cake equally.

examples.text: وزعنا التوت بالتساوي على التلات صواني.
examples.trans: We distributed the berries evenly across the three tins.

meanings.note: In the degree, grade, level, or step.

examples.text: نجح بالدرجة الأولى.
examples.trans: He succeeded with the first degree (top of the class).

examples.text: نجح بالدرجة الأولى بالمطبخ.
examples.trans: He passed with first-class honours in the kitchen.

meanings.note: Used when referring to pointing at something with a finger or signaling.

examples.text: ليش بتأشر علي؟
examples.trans: Why are you pointing at me?

examples.text: سلمى بتأشر عالنجمة الحمرا بالبلكونة.
examples.trans: Salma is pointing at the red star on the balcony.

meanings.note: Means to slacken, loosen a grip, or relax tension.

examples.text: لازم بترخي الحبل شوي.
examples.trans: You need to loosen the rope a bit.

examples.text: المي الدافية بترخي العجين وبتسهّل فرده.
examples.trans: Warm water relaxes the dough and makes it easy to roll out.

بتلف.gloss: you turn / she turns / you wrap

meanings.en: you turn / she turns / you wrap
meanings.note: Used for taking a turn while driving or walking, and for wrapping items like gifts or sandwiches.

examples.text: بتلف يمين عند الإشارة.
examples.trans: You turn right at the traffic light.

examples.text: بعد الشجرة الكبيرة بتلف يمين عالزقاق الضيق.
examples.trans: After the big tree you turn right into the narrow alley.

meanings.note: Refers to something being inside a sock or a small pouch/bag.

examples.text: حطيت المصاري بجراب.
examples.trans: I put the money in a sock.

examples.text: خبينا المفتاح الصغير بجراب صوف دافي.
examples.trans: We hid the small key inside a warm wool sock.

meanings.note: Used to express necessity or a requirement.

examples.text: بحتاج مساعدة في هذا الموضوع.
examples.trans: I need help with this matter.

examples.text: الشاي المغلي بحتاج خمس دقايق عشان يتخمر.
examples.trans: Boiling tea needs five minutes to steep properly.

meanings.note: Expresses placing or setting down a feminine object.

examples.text: الكتب وين بحطها؟
examples.trans: Where do I put the books?

examples.text: كل ما ألاقي ورقة قديمة بحطها جوا الدفتر.
examples.trans: Whenever I find an old sheet I put it inside the notebook.

meanings.note: Used to describe an action done gently, quickly, or with agility.

examples.text: نط من فوق السور بخفة.
examples.trans: He jumped over the wall nimbly.

examples.text: شال الغطا عن الصينية بخفة بدون ما يعمل صوت.
examples.trans: He lifted the lid off the tin lightly without making a sound.

meanings.note: Standard preposition for 'without', used identically to MSA.

examples.text: بحب القهوة بدون سكر.
examples.trans: I like coffee without sugar.

examples.text: شرب القهوة بدون سكر مع قطعة بقلاوة.
examples.trans: He drank the coffee without sugar alongside a piece of baklava.

meanings.note: Commonly used to describe going on trips, usually international or long-distance.

examples.text: كل صيف بسافر على العقبة.
examples.trans: Every summer I travel to Aqaba.

examples.text: خالي بسافر على العقبة كل شهر مرة.
examples.trans: My uncle travels to Aqaba once every month.

بشكل.gloss: in a way / in a shape

meanings.en: in a way / in a shape
meanings.note: Often used as a prefix for adverbs, e.g., 'bi-shakil ʿām' (generally).

examples.text: لازم نشتغل بشكل أسرع.
examples.trans: We need to work in a faster way.

examples.text: المكونات مخلوطة بشكل متساوي تماما.
examples.trans: The ingredients are mixed in a completely even way.

بغطا.gloss: with a cover / in a cover

meanings.en: with a cover / in a cover
meanings.note: Refers to a lid, cap, or a blanket covering something.

examples.text: سكر الطنجرة بغطا.
examples.trans: Close the pot with a lid.

examples.text: سكرنا المرطبان بغطا نحاس محكم.
examples.trans: We sealed the jar with a tight brass lid.

meanings.note: Used for navigation or metaphorically for direction.

examples.text: ضاع بالصحراء لأنه ما كان معه بوصلة.
examples.trans: He got lost in the desert because he didn't have a compass.

examples.text: اتبعنا إبرة البوصلة لحد ما وصلنا الشرق.
examples.trans: We followed the compass needle until we reached the east.

meanings.note: Used to explain or clarify a point.

examples.text: هذا الاشي بيعني انه احنا خلصنا.
examples.trans: This thing means that we are finished.

examples.text: هادا الرمز بيعني إنه الغرفة مسكرة من جوا.
examples.trans: This symbol means that the room is locked from inside.

meanings.note: Often a colloquial pronunciation or a typo of "تجبري" (tijibri), meaning to force someone or set a broken bone.

examples.text: ما بتقدري تجيبري حدا على شي ما بده ياه.
examples.trans: You cannot force anyone into something they don't want.

examples.text: لا تجيبري الضيوف ياكلوا إذا شبعانين.
examples.trans: Do not force the guests to eat if they are full.

meanings.note: The standard or rural/Bedouin pronunciation of the number 3.

examples.text: عندي ثلاثة أولاد.
examples.trans: I have three children.

examples.text: اقراوا الأسئلة الثلاثة بتركيز قبل الجواب.
examples.trans: Read the three questions carefully before answering.

meanings.note: The number 30 with the "th" sound preserved.

examples.text: دفع ثلاثين دينار حق التذكرة.
examples.trans: He paid thirty dinars for the ticket.

examples.text: الدفتر مكتوب قبل ثلاثين سنة تقريبا.
examples.trans: The notebook was written roughly thirty years ago.

meanings.note: Commonly used preposition for indicating proximity, next to, or beside.

examples.text: اقعد جنب أخوك.
examples.trans: Sit next to your brother.

examples.text: حطينا الصواني جنب النافورة بالظل.
examples.trans: We set the trays next to the fountain in the shade.

meanings.note: The standard Levantine Arabic word for 'inside' or 'inwards'.

examples.text: ادخل جوا الدار، الجو بارد.
examples.trans: Go inside the house, the weather is cold.

examples.text: العلبة المعدنية مخبية جوا الخزانة.
examples.trans: The metal tin is hidden inside the cupboard.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian masculine noun (plural: جيوب). Also homographic with imperative جيب ('bring!') from جاب.

examples.text: المفتاح جوا جيب الجاكيت.
examples.trans: The key is inside the jacket pocket.

examples.text: حطيت الساعة الصغيرة بجيبي.
examples.trans: I put the small watch in my pocket.

meanings.note: The metal iron. Used commonly in construction contexts or metaphorically for strength.

examples.text: هذا الباب من حديد.
examples.trans: This door is made of iron.

examples.text: قفل البوابة مصنوع من حديد قديم وتقيل.
examples.trans: The gate lock is made of old, heavy iron.

meanings.note: Used to refer to the edge of a table, cliff, or any physical boundary.

examples.text: دير بالك، الكاسة على حفة الطاولة.
examples.trans: Watch out, the cup is on the edge of the table.

examples.text: لا تحطي الفنجان على حفة الطاولة عشان ما يوقع.
examples.trans: Do not set the cup on the edge of the table so it does not fall.

meanings.note: Refers to a minor cut or scrape on a surface or skin.

examples.text: في خدش صغير على شاشة التلفون.
examples.trans: There is a small scratch on the phone screen.

examples.text: في خدش خفيف على غطا العلبة المعدنية.
examples.trans: There is a faint scratch on the lid of the metal tin.

meanings.note: Used for the material wood or timber.

examples.text: هاي الطاولة مصنوعة من خشب.
examples.trans: This table is made of wood.

examples.text: الصندوق مصنوع من خشب جوز قديم وناعم.
examples.trans: The chest is made of smooth old walnut wood.

meanings.note: Past tense verb in the first-person plural indicating fear.

examples.text: خفنا من صوت الانفجار.
examples.trans: We got scared of the explosion sound.

examples.text: ما خفنا من العتمة لأن معنا فوانيس.
examples.trans: We were not afraid of the dark because we had lanterns.

meanings.note: Adjective used to describe something feminine that is light in weight, intensity, or even a 'light-hearted' person (khafiifat dam).

examples.text: الأكلة هاي خفيفة على المعدة.
examples.trans: This meal is light on the stomach.

examples.text: نكهة الليمون خفيفة ومنعشة مع الشاي.
examples.trans: The lemon flavour is light and refreshing with tea.

meanings.note: The number five, used in counting abstractly or before masculine counted nouns.

examples.text: اشتريت خمسة كتب اليوم.
examples.trans: I bought five books today.

examples.text: عندنا خمسة أبواب خشب بتطلع عالحديقة.
examples.trans: We have five wooden doors leading out to the garden.

meanings.note: Used to describe warm weather, warm water, or a cozy feeling.

examples.text: الجو اليوم كثير دافي.
examples.trans: The weather today is very warm.

examples.text: الحليب الدافي بسكر الخميرة وبخليها تتفاعل.
examples.trans: Warm milk activates the yeast and helps it rise.

meanings.note: Essential Jordanian word used for giving directions ('go straight') or to mean doing something immediately.

examples.text: امشي دغري وبعدين لف يمين.
examples.trans: Walk straight and then turn right.

examples.text: امشي دغري لعند القوس وبعدين لف يسار.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead to the arch and then turn left.

meanings.note: Feminine form of the color blue. Also the name of a major Jordanian city.

examples.text: سيارتها زرقا.
examples.trans: Her car is blue.

examples.text: حطينا البطاقات بعلبة زرقا صغيرة عالرف.
examples.trans: We put the cards in a small blue tin on the shelf.

meanings.note: Usually implies olive oil in Jordan unless specified otherwise, but used for all oils.

examples.text: حط زيت وزعتر على الخبز.
examples.trans: Put oil and thyme on the bread.

examples.text: دهنا القالب بشوية زيت زيتون نضيف.
examples.trans: We greased the pan with a little clean olive oil.

meanings.note: Everyday word for a year.

examples.text: هالسيارة موديل السنة.
examples.trans: This car is this year's model.

examples.text: مرّت سنة كاملة على آخر زيارة للمزرعة.
examples.trans: A whole year has passed since the last visit to the farm.

meanings.note: Active participle plural form of the verb 'to smell'. Used like 'are you smelling...'.

examples.text: شامين ريحة حريق؟
examples.trans: Are you guys smelling something burning?

examples.text: شامين ريحة القرفة واللوز المحمص بالممر؟
examples.trans: Do you smell the scent of cinnamon and roasted almonds in the hall?

meanings.note: Everyday word for a tree.

examples.text: زرعنا شجرة زيتون بالحديقة.
examples.trans: We planted an olive tree in the garden.

examples.text: قعدنا تحت شجرة الزيزفون الكبيرة بالساحة.
examples.trans: We sat under the big linden tree in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian interrogative pronoun for 'what'.

examples.text: شو بتعمل هون؟
examples.trans: What are you doing here?

examples.text: شو المكون السري اللي ضفتيه عالعجينة؟
examples.trans: What is the secret ingredient that you added to the batter?

meanings.note: Imperative verb used when telling a single male to look or see.

examples.text: شوف العصفور على الشجرة.
examples.trans: Look at the bird on the tree.

examples.text: شوف الرقم المكتوب بقلم الرصاص عالزاوية!
examples.trans: Look at the number written in pencil in the corner!

meanings.note: Used to describe someone who creates or manufactures something.

examples.text: هذا صانع ماهر للأثاث.
examples.trans: He is a skilled furniture maker.

examples.text: صانع البوصلات القديم نقش اسمه عالغطا.
examples.trans: The old compass maker engraved his name on the lid.

meanings.note: Feminine singular adjective for small or young.

examples.text: السيارة صغيرة بس مريحة.
examples.trans: The car is small but comfortable.

examples.text: قطفنا ورقة نعناع صغيرة للتزيين.
examples.trans: We picked a small mint leaf for garnish.

meanings.note: Refers to tin plates or thin sheets of metal.

examples.text: سقف البيت القديم مصنوع من صفيح.
examples.trans: The roof of the old house is made of tin.

examples.text: العلبة مصنوعة من صفيح قديم مرسوم عليه ورد.
examples.trans: The tin is made of vintage sheet metal painted with roses.

meanings.note: Can mean solid, hard, or refer to steel (when used as a noun).

examples.text: هذا المعدن صلب جدا.
examples.trans: This metal is very solid.

examples.text: خشب الجوز صلب وبعيش سنين طويلة.
examples.trans: Walnut wood is solid and lasts for many years.

meanings.note: Used for giving directions (straight ahead) or referring to time (immediately).

examples.text: امشي طوالي وبعدين لف يمين.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead then turn right.

examples.text: روح طوالي لآخر الممر وبتلاقي المكتبة.
examples.trans: Go straight ahead to the end of the corridor and you will find the library.

meanings.note: Imperative feminine singular form for 'count'. Can also be the male name Oday (ʿUday), but verb is more common here.

examples.text: عدي من واحد لعشرة.
examples.trans: Count from one to ten.

examples.text: عدي حبات اللوز اللي حطيناهم عالوجه.
examples.trans: Count (f.) the almonds we placed on top.

meanings.note: Can refer to a cardboard box, a tin can, or a small container.

examples.text: افتح علبة التونة.
examples.trans: Open the can of tuna.

examples.text: البطاقات مرتبة جوا علبة صفيح مدهونة أزرق.
examples.trans: The cards are arranged inside a tin box painted blue.

meanings.note: Standard preposition for 'on', 'upon', or 'to'.

examples.text: الكتاب على الطاولة.
examples.trans: The book is on the table.

examples.text: حطينا الخريطة على الطاولة وبلشنا نحللها.
examples.trans: We laid the map on the table and began analysing it.

meanings.note: Can literally mean 'your age', but is often used idiomatically as 'have you ever'.

examples.text: عمرك سافرت على مصر؟
examples.trans: Have you ever traveled to Egypt?

examples.text: عمرك ذقت كيكة عسل مع شاي الزيزفون؟
examples.trans: Have you ever tasted honey cake with linden tea?

meanings.note: Used mostly in formal contexts, but occasionally spills into educated colloquial speech to mean 'then it is' or 'because it'.

examples.text: إذا بتدرس فإنه رح تنجح.
examples.trans: If you study, then indeed you will succeed.

examples.text: إذا اتبعنا البوصلة، فإنه رح نوصل للبوابة بسهولة.
examples.trans: If we follow the compass, then indeed we will reach the gate easily.

فتحت.gloss: I opened / you (m) opened / she opened

meanings.en: I opened / you (m) opened / she opened
meanings.note: Past tense verb meaning 'opened', conjugated for 1st person, 2nd person masc, or 3rd person fem.

examples.text: فتحت الشباك عشان يتهوى البيت.
examples.trans: I opened the window so the house airs out.

examples.text: سلمى فتحت الشباك الكبير عشان تشم الورد.
examples.trans: Salma opened the big window to smell the roses.

meanings.note: Used as a preposition or adverb meaning 'above', 'over', or 'upstairs'.

examples.text: الكتاب فوق الطاولة.
examples.trans: The book is on top of the table.

examples.text: الخريطة معلقة فوق الرف الخشبي بالمكتبة.
examples.trans: The map is hanging above the wooden shelf in the library.

meanings.note: Preposition for 'in' or 'at', and very commonly used to mean 'there is/are' (existential).

examples.text: في ناس كثير بالسوق.
examples.trans: There are many people in the market.

examples.text: في تلات بطاقات ملونة جوا الظرف الكبير.
examples.trans: There are three coloured cards inside the big envelope.

meanings.note: Preposition and adverb for time or sequence meaning 'prior to' or 'before'.

examples.text: لازم أوصل قبل الساعة خمسة.
examples.trans: I have to arrive before five o'clock.

examples.text: غسلنا الفواكه منيح قبل ما نقطعها للتذوق.
examples.trans: We washed the fruit thoroughly before slicing it for the tasting.

meanings.note: The primary interrogative word for quantity, price, or duration in Levantine Arabic.

examples.text: قديش حق هالكتاب؟
examples.trans: How much does this book cost?

examples.text: قديش ضايل وقت حتى تطلع الصينية التانية من الفرن؟
examples.trans: How much time is left until the second tray comes out of the oven?

meanings.note: Feminine adjective for things (not people) that are old, ancient, or outdated.

examples.text: عندي سيارة قديمة بس ممتازة.
examples.trans: I have an old car but it's excellent.

examples.text: لقينا خريطة قديمة مرسومة بالحبر جوا غلاف الدفتر.
examples.trans: We found an old map drawn in ink inside the notebook cover.

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian word for soon or near.

examples.text: راح أوصل قريب جدا.
examples.trans: I will arrive very soon.

examples.text: سلمى رح ترجع قريب ومعها مرطبان العسل الجبلي.
examples.trans: Salma will be back soon bringing the jar of mountain honey.

meanings.note: Refers to the material glass, a pane of glass, or sometimes a glass bottle.

examples.text: دير بالك، في قزاز مكسور عالأرض.
examples.trans: Careful, there is broken glass on the floor.

examples.text: انكسر مرطبان القزاز الصغير بس العسل ضل بالصحن.
examples.trans: The small glass jar broke, though the honey stayed in the dish.

meanings.note: Past tense of 'to be' for 3rd person masculine singular. Widely used as an auxiliary verb.

examples.text: الجو كان بارد امبارح.
examples.trans: The weather was cold yesterday.

examples.text: الطعم كان متوازن كتير بين العسل والليمون.
examples.trans: The flavour was very well balanced between the honey and lemon.

meanings.note: Extremely common adverb and adjective denoting abundance or intensity.

examples.text: أنا تعبان كثير اليوم.
examples.trans: I am very tired today.

examples.text: حطينا لوز محمص كثير على وجه الصينية الأولى.
examples.trans: We put lots of toasted almonds on top of the first tray.

meanings.note: The main interrogative word for asking about manner or state.

examples.text: كيف حالك اليوم؟
examples.trans: How are you today?

examples.text: كيف قدرت تفتح القفل القديم بدون ما تكسره؟
examples.trans: How did you manage to open the old lock without breaking it?

meanings.note: Everyday Jordanian word for 'no' or 'not', used exactly like Standard Arabic.

examples.text: لا، ما بدي أروح اليوم.
examples.trans: No, I don't want to go today.

examples.text: لا تنسوا تطفيوا الفرن بعد ما تخلصوا الخبيز.
examples.trans: Do not forget to turn off the oven after you finish baking.

لبرية.gloss: to the wild / to the outside

meanings.en: to the wild / to the outside
meanings.note: Often refers to an outdoor area, nature, or sometimes a wasteland depending on context.

examples.text: طلعنا لبرية عمان نشم هوا.
examples.trans: We went out to the wilderness of Amman to get some fresh air.

examples.text: سافروا لبرية الأردن بالربيع عشان يشموا هوا نقي.
examples.trans: They went out to the Jordanian countryside in spring to breathe fresh air.

meanings.note: Very common Jordanian word to indicate that an action is ongoing or hasn't happened yet.

examples.text: لسا ما خلصت شغلي.
examples.trans: I still haven't finished my work.

examples.text: الكيكة لسا بالفرن وبدها كمان خمس دقايق.
examples.trans: The cake is still in the oven and needs five more minutes.

meanings.note: Typically used when referring to a time limit, meaning up to the fifth hour or up to the number five.

examples.text: رح أضل أشتغل للخمسة.
examples.trans: I will keep working until five.

examples.text: المكتبة بتضل فاتحة كل يوم للخمسة العصر.
examples.trans: The library stays open every day until five in the afternoon.

meanings.note: Used in religious contexts, oaths, or expressions of exasperation or gratitude (e.g. 'الحمد لله').

examples.text: اعمل الخير لوجه لله.
examples.trans: Do good for the sake of God.

examples.text: العمل المتقن لوجه لله دايما فيه بركة.
examples.trans: Work done sincerely for the sake of God always carries blessing.

meanings.note: Common conjunction used to introduce a time clause, distinct from the question word 'when' (mita).

examples.text: رن علي لما توصل البيت.
examples.trans: Call me when you reach home.

examples.text: لما بردت الكيكة صبينا فوقها العسل الدافي.
examples.trans: When the cake cooled, we poured the warm honey over it.

meanings.note: Indicates movement or position towards the rear or back direction.

examples.text: ارجع لورا شوي عشان تمرق السيارة.
examples.trans: Go back a bit so the car can pass.

examples.text: ارجعوا خطوتين لورا عشان تشوفوا النقش اللي فوق القوس.
examples.trans: Step two paces backwards so you can see the carving above the arch.

meanings.note: Used mostly as a negative particle for verbs ('didn't') or as a relative pronoun/conjunction ('what' or 'that which').

examples.text: ما أكلت إشي من الصبح.
examples.trans: I haven't eaten anything since the morning.

examples.text: ما عرفت إنه العلبة فيها طابق سري من تحت.
examples.trans: I did not know that the box had a secret compartment underneath.

meanings.note: Passive participle indicating that an object has been set down or positioned somewhere.

examples.text: المفتاح محطوط على الطاولة.
examples.trans: The key is placed on the table.

examples.text: المرطبان الدهبي محطوط على أعلى رف بالمطبخ.
examples.trans: The golden jar is placed on the highest shelf in the kitchen.

meanings.note: Describes a feminine object (or plural non-human) that has a design, hole, or text carved into it.

examples.text: هاي اللوحة محفورة من الخشب.
examples.trans: This panel is carved from wood.

examples.text: النجمة الصغيرة محفورة جوا الحجر فوق الباب.
examples.trans: The small star is carved into the stone above the door.

meanings.note: Fabric name, also used metaphorically to describe something very soft or luxurious (e.g., 'mukamali' for elite).

examples.text: اشتريت فستان مخمل لونه أحمر.
examples.trans: I bought a red velvet dress.

examples.text: العلبة مبطنة بقماش مخمل أحمر ناعم من جوا.
examples.trans: The box is lined with soft red velvet fabric on the inside.

meanings.note: Used for flat surfaces like roofs or fields.

examples.text: سطح البيت مسطح.
examples.trans: The roof of the house is flat.

examples.text: فردنا العجينة على لوح خشب مسطح ونضيف.
examples.trans: We rolled the dough out on a clean, flat wooden board.

meanings.note: One of the most basic Arabic prepositions indicating origin.

examples.text: أنا من الأردن.
examples.trans: I am from Jordan.

examples.text: جبنا العسل البلدي الصافي من مزرعة قريبة.
examples.trans: We brought the pure local honey from a nearby farm.

meanings.note: Levantine equivalent for 'jayyida', feminine form.

examples.text: الفكرة منيحة كثير.
examples.trans: The idea is very good.

examples.text: نتيجة التذوق طلعت منيحة وأحسن من المرة الأولى.
examples.trans: The tasting result came out good and better than the first time.

meanings.note: Used for literal weight or metaphorically for a balanced, rational person or idea.

examples.text: قراراتها دايماً موزونة.
examples.trans: Her decisions are always balanced.

examples.text: المقادير موزونة بالميزان بدقة عشان ما تخرب الوصفة.
examples.trans: The ingredients are weighed on the scale accurately so the recipe does not fail.

meanings.note: Can refer to objects lacking moisture or metaphorically to a rude or blunt person.

examples.text: الخبز ناشف، ما بيتاكل.
examples.trans: The bread is dry, it can't be eaten.

examples.text: لازم نمسح الصحن بمنديل ناشف قبل ما نحط الكيكة.
examples.trans: We must wipe the plate with a dry cloth before putting the cake on.

meanings.note: Everyday word for attempting something or tasting food.

examples.text: خلينا نجرب هالمطعم الجديد.
examples.trans: Let's try this new restaurant.

examples.text: تعالوا نجرب نخلط الزيزفون مع قشر الليمون بالشاي.
examples.trans: Come let us try mixing linden with lemon zest in the tea.

meanings.note: Used for celestial stars, geometric shapes, or famous celebrities.

examples.text: السما مليانة نجوم اليوم.
examples.trans: The sky is full of stars today.

examples.text: رسموا نجمة صغيرة بالحبر الأحمر جنب الرقم سبعة.
examples.trans: They drew a small star in red ink beside the number seven.

meanings.note: Used for the metal or objects made of it.

examples.text: هذا الإبريق مصنوع من نحاس.
examples.trans: This jug is made of copper.

examples.text: الإبريق والمصفاية معمولين من نحاس مطروق قديم.
examples.trans: The teapot and strainer are made of old hammered copper.

meanings.note: Used for wood shavings left after carpentry.

examples.text: الأرض مليانة نشارة خشب.
examples.trans: The floor is full of sawdust.

examples.text: كان في نشارة خشب ناعمة عالأرض جوا الورشة.
examples.trans: There was fine sawdust on the floor inside the workshop.

meanings.note: Colloquial verb for bending metal or denting a car.

examples.text: دير بالك لا نطعج السيارة.
examples.trans: Be careful so we don't dent the car.

examples.text: دير بالك لا نطعج أطراف الورقة واحنا بنحطها بالعلبة.
examples.trans: Be careful we do not bend the edges of the sheet while putting it in the tin.

meanings.note: A very common herb used in Levantine tea and cuisine.

examples.text: بدي كاسة شاي مع نعنع.
examples.trans: I want a cup of tea with mint.

examples.text: حطينا عرق نعنع أخضر بالكاسة قبل ما نصب الشاي.
examples.trans: We put a sprig of fresh mint in the glass before pouring the tea.

meanings.note: Can refer to a physical dot, a score point, or a drop of liquid.

examples.text: بدي نقطة مي بس.
examples.trans: I just want a drop of water.

examples.text: التقت الخطوط كلها عند نقطة واحدة بالزاوية الشمالية.
examples.trans: All the lines met at a single point in the northern corner.

meanings.note: Commonly used for turning a vehicle or wrapping food.

examples.text: خلينا نلف من هذا الشارع.
examples.trans: Let's turn from this street.

examples.text: لازم نلف السندويشات بورق عشان ما تبرد عالطريق.
examples.trans: We need to wrap the sandwiches in paper so they don't get cold on the way.

meanings.note: Points out an aroma or odor.

examples.text: من وين جاية هالريحة الحلوة؟
examples.trans: Where is this nice smell coming from?

examples.text: هالريحة الزاكية جاية من المخبز اللي تحتنا.
examples.trans: This delicious smell is coming from the bakery downstairs.

meanings.note: Standard adverb for physical location.

examples.text: حط الأغراض هون لو سمحت.
examples.trans: Put the things here, please.

examples.text: الجو هون بالجبل أبرد بكثير من وسط البلد.
examples.trans: The weather up here on the hill is much cooler than downtown.

meanings.note: Conjunction and indefinite noun.

examples.text: جيب معك خيط وإبرة.
examples.trans: Bring a thread and a needle with you.

examples.text: جابت تيته بكرة خيط وإبرة عشان ترقع الثوب.
examples.trans: Grandma brought a spool of thread and a needle to patch the robe.

meanings.note: Cardinal number or used as an indefinite pronoun.

examples.text: في واحد بيسأل عنك.
examples.trans: There is someone asking about you.

examples.text: اشتريت كتاب واحد بس من المعرض لأنه كان غالي.
examples.trans: I bought just one book from the fair because it was expensive.

meanings.note: Conjunction attached to a feminine imperative verb.

examples.text: امسكي الصندوق وارفعي لفوق.
examples.trans: Hold the box and lift it up.

examples.text: امسكي طرف السجادة من هناك وارفعي شوي لفوق.
examples.trans: Hold the edge of the rug from over there and lift it up a little.

meanings.note: Feminine command to push or press.

examples.text: حطي الباسورد واضغطي انتر.
examples.trans: Enter the password and press enter.

examples.text: اختاري اللغة العربية واضغطي على زر الحفظ.
examples.trans: Choose the Arabic language and press the save button.

meanings.note: Preposition with a 3rd person masculine singular pronoun suffix.

examples.text: امشي وراه.
examples.trans: Walk behind him.

examples.text: ركضت وراه للموقف عشان أعطيه مفتاحه اللي نسيه.
examples.trans: I ran after him to the bus stop to give him his key that he forgot.

meanings.note: Refers to a scent, often used when describing food or perfume.

examples.text: الأكل زاكي وريحة بتشهي.
examples.trans: The food is delicious and the smell is appetizing.

examples.text: المطر نزل على التراب وريحة الأرض صارت بتجنن.
examples.trans: The rain fell on the soil and the scent of the earth became wonderful.

meanings.note: Used as a collective noun for paper or leaves.

examples.text: أعطاني قلم وورق.
examples.trans: He gave me a pen and paper.

examples.text: جبنا من المكتبة ألوان مائية وورق مقوى للمشروع.
examples.trans: We picked up watercolors and cardstock paper from the stationery shop for the project.

meanings.note: Vocative particle used when addressing someone directly.

examples.text: يا أحمد، تعال هون.
examples.trans: Oh Ahmed, come here.

examples.text: يا سيدي، تفضل اشرب معنا فنجان قهوة قبل ما تروح.
examples.trans: Sir, please come have a cup of coffee with us before you leave.

meanings.note: Refers to abandoning or leaving a feminine object or person.

examples.text: قرر يتركها ويروح.
examples.trans: He decided to leave it and go.

examples.text: ما قدر يتركها لحالها بالمستشفى وضل قاعد عندها.
examples.trans: He couldn't leave her alone at the hospital and stayed sitting with her.
